status: frozen after V19H source-map hashing and V19I member-field failure but before reading any frozen soft-band science array, calculating a gradient, score, ridge, profile, or bootstrap, visually inspecting a science map, opening a replacement-cluster lensing target, or selecting a gravity formula
purpose: Resolve the numerical implementation choices left implicit by the V19H automated-front estimator and execute the same target-blind source-only X-ray discontinuity search in the Bullet Cluster and Abell 2146.

local_normal.smoothed_rate: R_sigma=G_sigma*(C-B)/(G_sigma*E), using zero outside the frozen map and dividing only where the smoothed exposure is positive
local_normal.gradient: centered finite difference of R_sigma in logical image pixels; atan2(dR/dy,dR/dx) points from the fainter toward the brighter side
local_normal.assignment: nearest directed orientation center by wrapped angular distance; exact ties choose the lower integer bin

poisson_step_score.side_kernels: within radius three sigma, split the isotropic Gaussian kernel by positive or negative dot product with the assigned local normal; pixels exactly on the dividing line contribute to neither side
poisson_step_score.variance_each_side: V_s=sum w_s^2(C+V_B)/(sum w_s E)^2, where V_B is the frozen scaled-background variance
poisson_step_score.side_valid_fraction: sum w_s M/sum w_s, where M is the frozen binary analysis mask
poisson_step_score.zero_or_nonfinite_denominator_rule: mark invalid and never repair or floor the score

scale_space_nonmaximum.normal_direction: retain a pixel only when its Z is not lower than the bilinearly sampled Z one logical pixel in either direction along its assigned normal
scale_space_nonmaximum.scale_direction: retain a pixel only at the candidate physical scale having the largest finite Z at that pixel; exact ties choose the smaller scale

ridge_linking.gap_implementation: binary closing with a Euclidean disk whose radius is floor((maximum gap/2)/pixel scale); this cannot bridge an empty straight-line gap longer than the frozen maximum
ridge_linking.skeletonization: eight-connected one-pixel skeleton after closing, followed by eight-connected component labeling
ridge_linking.projected_length: sum each unique horizontal or vertical skeleton edge as one pixel scale and each unique diagonal edge as sqrt(2) pixel scales
ridge_linking.curvature: unweighted algebraic least-squares circle fit to all skeleton coordinates in physical kpc; reject a singular fit
ridge_linking.component_score: sum Z^2/2 over skeleton pixels, used only to rank automatically retained ridges
ridge_linking.representative_position: Z^2-weighted mean of skeleton physical coordinates
ridge_linking.representative_normal: circular mean of the signed fainter-to-brighter local normals weighted by Z^2

profile_and_uncertainty_boundary.this_stage: construct and hash the complete scale score cube, nonmaximum ridge mask, skeleton, and retained ridge catalog
profile_and_uncertainty_boundary.next_stage_only_if_each_cluster_has_a_re: run the inherited projected broken-power-law Poisson profile fits and exactly 1000 parametric bootstraps without changing any ridge threshold or choosing a ridge by a temperature or lensing outcome

synthetic_fixtures.uniform_exposure_step: a curved two-rate Poisson fixture must produce at least one retained ridge within one Gaussian sigma of the injected arc
synthetic_fixtures.uniform_field: a noiseless uniform-rate fixture must produce zero retained ridges
synthetic_fixtures.masked_edge: a step whose two-sided valid fractions are below 0.9 must not be retained

gates.failure_rule: fail source-front identifiability; do not lower the score, length, curvature, gap, or valid-fraction thresholds, change orientation count, use a published coordinate or sector, drop an observation, inspect lensing, or select a different implementation after seeing the maps
